headline: Sumit Woods Limited: SEBI Takeover Regulation 31(4) Disclosure Filed
sum: Sumit Woods Limited filed a mandatory substantial acquisition of shares disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), indicating a change in control or significant shareholding event requiring public disclosure on NSE.
detail: Under SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4), any person acquiring shares of a listed company must file a disclosure with the stock exchange and the company once they cross prescribed thresholds (5%, 10%, 15%, 20%, 25% etc.). This NSE filing by or regarding Sumit Woods Limited represents such a mandatory disclosure event, likely triggered by a significant shareholder acquisition. The specific acquirer identity, shareholding percentage, and consideration remain undisclosed in the Bar & Bench reference.
